text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The grand culmination of this year's dirt 
season, the Tokyo Daishoten. All eyes are 
on Hokko Tarumae to see if she can follow 
up her Champions Cup win with another 
glorious victory!

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Residents
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I wonder if Tarumae-chan is 
nervous? Things have turned into quite a 
huge commotion...!

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, let's believe in our star. 
Come on, let's get the banner ready!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
choice_data_list: Now all that's left is to give it our all.
Now all that's left is to give it our all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Today, I will run. For the people of 
Tomakomai. For everyone cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
With all my heart and soul, I'll shine. 
This is me. This is the star of Tomakomai. 
This is Hokko Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I promise, I'll return to your side.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Things won't go like they did at the 
Champions Cup. Today, I'll prove it once 
and for all! The unshakeable power of my 
feng shui!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, Ricky-chan is all prepped and 
ready, and I'm ready-steady too~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
By matching everyone's brilliance against 
each other, let's make this Tokyo 
Daishoten the most dazzling stage in the 
whole world.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I won't lose. Not to either of you, and 
not to anyone else!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's do this! It's time for 
our—"Tokyo Daishoten"!!
